what: release latency of live paper bars (bar close_time -> released to the simulator), journaled per batch as release_latency_ms (sim/paper.py)
source: M6 exports of three real recorded Windows paper sessions (owner PC), staged 2026-11-10; observed bars only
method: nearest-rank percentiles over every observed bar batch
consequence: every observed release is > 0 ms and < 60 s after the close, so a live entry decided at close T executes at the first 1m open at or after the release, i.e. T + 1 min + 1 ms (the second open after the decision), never T + 1 ms
rule: SIMULATION.md §2: backtests assume a decision latency at least the observed live p95
